reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and already gave this month, B answers my real worries: it names the Majestic, guarantees all-or-nothing refunds, shows $11,000 already pledged in writing, promises spending reports and a reopening date, and is upfront about the roof risk. A has placeholder names, no refund guarantee, and a "half of what we asked last time" claim that feels like spin.
